summary: Riding a minecart cluster into a wall freezes the game
description: Derailed Minecarts that are clustered together often keep their movement speed, which is due to another bug (). In some cases (with the Minecart Improvements experiment enabled) if such clusters of minecarts are ridden by the player and collide with blocks, the screen goes black and the game stops working. It then has to be terminated manually. Steps to reproduce (or use the link below for a more reliable method): - Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail. - Push the minecarts. They should now start to move off the rail, keeping their velocity. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into blocks (2 blocks high is best). Water like in the attached videos isn t needed. This is not very reliable, so a few attempts may be needed. Alternatively, the attached world ( ) can be used to reproduce the bug: - Open the world. - Walk into the minecart cluster. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into the wall and locks the game.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail.
3. Push the minecarts so that they start moving off the rail, keeping their velocity.
4. Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster.
5. Wait until the minecart collides into blocks (preferably 2 blocks high).
6. Observe that the screen goes black and the game stops working.

Alternatively:
1. Open the attached world file provided for reproduction.
2. Walk into the pre-placed minecart cluster.
3. Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster.
4. Wait until it collides into the wall.
5. Observe that the screen goes black and the game stops working.
Observed Behavior:
When riding a cluster of derailed minecarts that maintain their velocity, and this cluster collides with blocks while the Minecart Improvements experiment is enabled, the game freezes. The screen goes black, and the game stops responding, necessitating manual termination. To reproduce this issue, place approximately 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail and push them so they move off the rail while retaining their speed. Then, ride one of these minecarts in the cluster until it collides with blocks, ideally two blocks high. This method is not very reliable, so multiple attempts may be required. Alternatively, use the attached world file to reproduce the bug: open the world, walk into the minecart cluster, ride one of the minecarts, and wait for it to collide with a wall, causing the game to freeze.

This behavior occurs specifically when the Minecart Improvements experiment is enabled, and the collision results in a complete game lockup.
Expected Behavior: When a cluster of derailed minecarts, ridden by the player, collides with blocks, the game should not freeze. Instead, the minecarts should come to a stop upon impact, and the player should be safely ejected or remain inside without any visual or functional disruptions. The game should continue running normally without requiring manual termination.
